reviews.title: Great PSU for the Money
reviews.comment: Awesome PSU, great bang for the buck. I had some difficulty plugging in cables but that is more of an issue for me then the PSU itself. Build quality and finishes are excellent and I have had 0 issues with functionality in a MicroATX build. I would consider the fan to be truly "silent" and the clean black look is great. A winner all around!

reviews.author: Jaime

reviews.title: This powered my new (and extremely power hungry) build with no issues
reviews.comment: Why I ordered this item: My new audio production (with a side of gaming) desktop needed something beefy to power the 9900x CPU and 7900XT graphics card. Likes: * This thing hit every single mark I was looking for in a power supply! * It's fully modular. * It is virtually silent when running at full steam. * It fits my Lian Li mATX case perfectly. * The power has been consistent and flawless so far. * The heat is relatively low thanks to (I assume) the efficiency. * This PSU is lowest cost than others I researched. * I've used Rosewill power supplies for my last four builds and I've been thrilled with all of them, so I have some loyalty to this brand. No likes: * So far I have not found a single thing I don't like about this PSU. Would I pay full price for this product: Yes, because I did! Final thoughts: What a great power supply this is. A perfect power supply is not something you think of often because it just works and does not require maintenance beyond the occasional vacuuming out. Other than writing this review I have not thought about this PSU a single time!
